messages:
emma: Heads-up: Large bank wants a clear launch checklist for compliance features before committing to Dedicated. They called out 4 things: SOC2 evidence exports, tenant-level BYOK lifecycle controls, per-route retention exceptions, and a signed export manifest. Need product+legal+infra alignment.

jon: Quick clarifying q: Do they need exports to be queryable (searchable) or just packaged artifacts for legal review? That changes index requirements.

arjun: Bank said both. Day-to-day ops want searchable exports; legal wants sealed bundles for audits. So we need dual-mode export.

sasha: For SOC2 mapping, we should produce a short control matrix that maps export fields -> control IDs (e.g., CC6.1 audit logs, CC7.2 key rotation). I'll draft a template.

kevin: BYOK notes: we have to prove key provenance in exports but never include key material. Include key_fingerprint, kms_vendor, last_rotation_ts. Also surface key events in audit log with immutability.

emma: Retention granularity ask: they want to set retention per-route (chat vs attachments) and override per-tenant. That implies retention policy evaluation at query time and on delete paths.

jon: Engineering concern: retroactive retention changes across large datasets are expensive. Propose a strategy: mark records with a retention_tag and evaluate effective_retention on read; for deletes, use tombstones and a background compaction job. This avoids full reindex.

arjun: Agreed. We should document compaction as a long-window async op and warn customers about timeline. Also include a fast-path for legal hold toggles that flip tombstone->active without reindex.

sasha: Manifest proposal (minimal fields): tenant_id, export_id, generated_at, export_mode (searchable|sealed), retention_policy_snapshot, redaction_profile_used, signature_algorithm, verifier_hint. I'll post a JSON schema.

kevin: Security requirement: signatures must be verifiable with a published verifier and include an attestation statement (who generated, hash of included index shards). BYOK handshake must be testable end-to-end before pilot.

compliance-bot: reminder: attach SOC2 control mapping when you post the manifest draft.

emma: Launch acceptance checklist (draft):
- manifest schema reviewed by Legal + Security
- BYOK handshake test: rotate key -> export -> verifier validates attestation
- Per-route retention override: demo in Console and validated on sample historic data (no full reindex)
- Sealed export generation: signed bundle + manifest, retrievable and verifiable by customer
- Monitoring: per-tenant SLA dashboard (search p95, export latency), alerting on failures

jon: Perf targets: searchable exports p95 <= 5s for T0 under pilot QPS (we'll define QPS). Sealed export generation async SLA <= 2h for <10GB bundles.

arjun: Cost tradeoffs: dedicated shards per-tenant are costly. Recommend pilot uses shared index with tenant-aware resource limits + possible vertical isolation for hot tenants. We'll provide cost delta for dedicated pool option.

sasha: Legal question: allow on-demand redaction at export? They asked for it. Legal prefers explicit redaction_profile and audit trail. Product stance: allow but queue as long-running export with extra audit fields.

emma: Action items:
- sasha -> manifest schema + SOC2 control matrix (due Mon)
- jon -> perf harness + shared-index pilot plan + cost delta (due Tue)
- kevin -> BYOK test vectors + verifier example (due Tue)
- arjun -> retention-tag read-path impl note + compaction runbook draft (due Wed)

kevin: I'll also add log entries we need for key rotation and export verification so Compliance can approve.

emma: Let's reconvene Wed 9am PT to review artifacts. If all green we add this to pilot scope and update the customer kickoff doc. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
